messages:
Priya Rao: Pushed a short PR that consolidates troubleshooting for 429 / timeouts / context-limit hits. Focused on action items: how to detect, repro, and pick fallback vs trim. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1893

Alex Kim: Thanks — can you add a minimal Node and curl example for backoff + jitter? Also include a clear note about honoring Retry-After only when it's trustworthy (server time skew can happen).

Priya Rao: Added a tiny Node snippet and a curl loop. For Retry-After I added guidance: prefer honoring when present, but if values look absurd (e.g., >1h) fall back to exponential cap. Open to wording tweaks.

Dmitri Petrov: One important streaming caveat: we should explicitly warn against automatic retries on partial stream failures. I put a comment in the PR suggesting a boxed callout with an example of unsafe retry (resume vs restart).

Lana Ortiz: Also suggest including a quick decision flow: response code -> headers -> suggested action. People keep confusing 413-like context-limit responses vs 429. A 3-line table would help.

Priya Rao: Added a compact decision list: (1) if 413 or body says "context too long" => trim/chunk; (2) if 429 => backoff + jitter, respect Retry-After; (3) if 500/503 transient => retry but be conservative for long-running streams.

Alex Kim: For repros, can we add a tiny bash burst script that hits the sandbox to produce 429s locally? I have one that reliably produces transient 429s in dev. Will paste.

Dmitri Petrov: Please include an explicit example showing how to detect Retry-After in both numeric seconds and HTTP-date formats. Many clients only handle seconds.

Priya Rao: Good point. I added parsing examples for both. Also included a short snippet that caps Retry-After to 120s.

Alex Kim: Burst script below — add to "Reproducing rate limits" section with a warning to use sandbox keys only:

```bash
# lightweight burst to provoke 429s in sandbox
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"test"}' &
  sleep 0.15
done
wait
```

Priya Rao: Thanks — grafted that in. I also added a small Node pseudocode showing: try up to 5 times, exponential backoff with jitter, if 413 then call trimPromptOnce() and retry only once. Keeping it intentionally small.

docs-bot: PR 1893 by priya — CI: docs-lint passed, link-checker warnings: 1 (internal anchor).

Lana Ortiz: Which SDK pages will we backport this to? Error-ref, streaming, and the JS SDK examples ideally. CS and Solutions will want a short blurb they can paste.

Priya Rao: Plan: merge into main once reviews done, then backport a condensed blurb to /error-reference and /sdk/js/errors. I'll add a changelog line.

Alex Kim: I'll review the Node example and the Retry-After parsing tonight. Quick ask: add a one-line note about proxies sometimes converting 503->429 (seen in some enterprise setups).

Dmitri Petrov: Also flag websockets: if the session state is server-side, do not auto-retry; if idempotent request, retries OK. I left a small wording suggestion.

Priya Rao: Great notes — will push an update addressing proxy and websocket caveats. Assigning reviewers @Alex Kim @Dmitri Petrov. Merge after approvals.

Lana Ortiz: Thanks! Ill ping product-help after merge with a 2-sentence summary for CS.

Priya Rao: Thanks everyone. If anyone has additional repro snippets (nginx proxy timeouts, websocket-resume example), drop them here and Ill see if there's room for a short note.
